svg.text: Dispatch logic, decoupled into layers
Six layers; each depends only on what the layer above hands over; arrows say what is passed down
1. Data layer What the official data can and cannot see
- Official station snapshots: bikes and free docks per station, every 5/15/30 minutes; only docked bikes are visible, off-dock bikes are not
- Off-dock bikes: a self-estimated upper bound of 4,262 from official data (a scenario assumption, not a measurement)
- Natural returns: historical returns per station per 10 minutes, weekdays and holidays kept apart
v Hands over: docked bikes per station, dock counts, estimated reserve bikes
2. Geometry layer 2 km circles
- A station within 2,000 m of a circle centre belongs to it; circles may overlap; a station in several circles splits its bikes and docks evenly
- 96 circles: 72 main circles plus island groups; island groups use their own reserve bikes and are not merged into the main circles
v Hands over: the stations of each circle, the evenly split bikes and docks
3. Regional level layer (trucks: balance within 2 km) Moves totals, does not react to single events
- Target = each station's own usual level x docks; shortage = target minus current (docked plus estimated reserve)
- Move directly within 2 km first, then use reserve bikes; what is still short is the remaining shortage
- Four windows 05:30, 10:00, 15:30, 23:00; pre-position off-peak, no trucks at peak; one batch every 30 minutes, logged
v Hands over: shortage per circle, dispatch within 2 km, remaining shortage
4. Forward-routing layer Order moves between circles into routes
- Capacity 14; each leg at most 2 km; no backtracking (all legs inside one 120-degree sector)
- Leave from depots at an assumed 40 km/h, detour factor 1.3; the result is the number of trucks and the latest departure time
v Hands over: forward routes, number of trucks, latest departure
5. Station layer (motorbike staff, peak) Changes layer only, never moves totals
- Re-dock off-dock bikes at the station: totals unchanged, no vehicle movement needed
- The station-level shortage list is ranked by each station's target and current level
v Hands over: station-level actual and target
6. Measurement layer Replay estimates, not operating results
- Remaining shortage, number of trucks and the sensitivity table; no counterfactual, with limits stated on every page
- The older method of converting shortage events divided by 14 into truck trips is no longer used
-> Output: slides and reports
Architecture sketch (public, simplified) | Algorithmic replay, not operating results
